item.title: Warmer Wednesday, rain returns Thursday, pleasant this weekend
item.description: Wednesday remains dry despite a mostly cloudy sky, with high temperatures near or slightly above 70°. Wednesday night looks mostly cloudy with low temperatures only falling into the mid 50s at most.

item.title: Alabama House passes bill to criminalize disruptions of worship services
item.description: A bill that would criminalize the disruption of religious services has passed the Alabama House of Representatives.

item.title: Pay It Forward: Ronnie Doughty of Montgomery
item.description: Ronnie Doughty of Montgomery is a teacher in Montgomery Public Schools. He has made it his mission to help students.

item.title: Alabama Shakespeare Festival preparing for summer camps
item.description: The Alabama Shakespeare Festival offers a unique way for students and adults to spend their summer, by holding summer camps and acting academies for those who want to experience the stage.

item.title: Disability advocates rally in front of Alabama State House
item.description: People with disabilities from across the state, family members and advocates are promoting Disability Advocacy Day on the steps of the Alabama State House.

item.title: Montgomery man sentenced to 40 years in fatal gas station shooting
item.description: A Montgomery man has been sentenced to 40 years in federal prison following a fatal shooting at a gas station.
